name: illians_horseman
description: an Illians Horseman, an old rider with a long white beard in a white fur hood and a white fur cloak over blue-white steel armour and brown boots, a round white shield with a blue snowflake emblem on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped spear with a brown wooden shaft in his LEFT hand, riding a white horse with a white mane and tail, a grey-blue harness and grey-blue hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round snowflake shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
